about: Linkup finds three sustainability news articles; each is stored and Slack is told three were found

news.title: EU agrees 2040 climate target of 90% emissions cut
news.content: EU environment ministers backed a 2040 goal of cutting net emissions by 90% from 1990 levels, allowing limited use of international credits.

news.title: Steelmaker opens first hydrogen-ready furnace in Sweden
news.content: The plant replaces coking coal with hydrogen made from renewable power and aims to cut site emissions by 95% by 2030.

news.title: SBTi publishes revised corporate net-zero standard
news.content: The revised standard tightens rules on scope 3 targets and sets new requirements for removals used to neutralise residual emissions.

reads.note: Linkup search, POST /v1/search with a JSON body (q, depth standard, outputType structured, structuredOutputSchema as text, fromDate, includeImages) and the bearer credential; with outputType structured Linkup answers the object the schema describes

writeReplies.note: chat.postMessage to the channel, n8n's workflow link turned off in the template

expect.offline: The trigger carries pinned data in the template (a run of July 2025), which the bench's pin of the same item keeps. Linkup's structured output answers the schema the request sends (a news list) as the response body itself. Each article is stored one at a time (Loop Over Items, batch 1) with a 2 s Wait between; when the loop is done, Aggregate makes one item whose data list counts the stored records for the Slack message. Linkup's fromDate is $now minus 7 days on n8n's unfrozen clock; the fixture does not depend on it.
